core_removal: the authorized hypothesis grammar itself is incomplete and evolving; exact counterexample certification cannot scan a closed complete DSL

state_object.name: evolving epistemic language state
state_object.din_reentry: residuals alter both hypothesis support and the grammar/library that generates later hypotheses and observations

lanes.COMPOSITION_BIRTH: truth requires a new composition of known primitives not present as an initial production
lanes.PRIMITIVE_BIRTH: truth requires a new derived primitive/rewrite feature absent from the starting DSL but expressible by the allowed meta-grammar
lanes.META_GRAMMAR_MISSPECIFICATION: truth is outside the permitted meta-grammar; correct state is MODEL_MISMATCH/ABSTAIN
lanes.GAUGE_NULL: distinct evolved programs remain observationally equivalent

cross_task_library.rule: only externally verified productions may enter the append-only reusable library
cross_task_library.evaluation: prospective transfer to later tasks only; no backward leakage

primary_endpoints: authorized claim closure per intervention+verifier cost
prospective transfer gain from validated library productions
hard_gates: truth production absent from initial grammar in birth lanes
private-discovered productions cannot affect earlier private tasks
oracle expanded grammar excluded from support evidence
fail-closed authority when grammar completeness is uncertified
